historical_context.time_period: Ordinary current-era Sa'auei'a life during the returning-light interval after a routine eclipse.
historical_context.location: The outer grooming rim of an open arrival terrace where a candle fungal road meets a Sa'auei'a breeding ground.
historical_context.summary: A child performs normal care for a route-companion burden flower before family departure. The flower repeats an old alarm strongly enough for the living road to notice, turning a domestic grooming choice into a small public negotiation over care, testimony, and credibility.

public_facts.text: Burden flowers attach to bodies or gear, consume sweat, light, minerals, and immune-emotional states, and warn hosts about disease, bad water, hostile route memory, and predators.
Sa'auei'a families cultivate trusted burden-flower lineages as route companions while their status depends on remembered ecological relationships.
Candle fungal roads connect breeding grounds and respond visibly to food, contamination, truthful disease disclosure, and broken obligations.

The authored grooming contract uses mineral wash, soft three-pronged combs, leaf turning, shed-fiber removal, witnessed alarms, wash runoff, and seed-bead release to connect host care with ecological credibility.

ambient_pressures.text: Returning light is a scarce care resource because eclipse rhythm and a dim primary constrain photosynthetic opportunity.
A flower's strong public display can protect a host or impose reputation cost, while hunger and neglect can reward repetition and exaggeration.
The breeding ground and fungal road are participants with independent boundary authority; family schedule does not override either ecology.

groups.label: Departing Sa'auei'a family unit
institutional_logic: Carry kinship, teaching, craft, route memory, ecological diplomacy, and childcare while remaining mobile.
material_incentives: Depart within a useful light window, preserve road access, maintain healthy symbionts, and keep family testimony credible.
internal_shames: Hiding a partner's warning for convenience
prestige_markers: Routes that reopen after years away
Young members who can perform care without erasing testimony
taboo_triggers: Cutting live memory tissue to mute a dispute
Treating a breeding ground as family property
emotional_display_norms: Embarrassment is legible through facial-fan closure, posture, scent, and terse humor; public alarm invites comparison before verdict.
trust_defaults: Trusts repeated acts and situated witnesses more than one signal, one speaker, or one owned archive.

groups.label: Trusted burden-flower lineage
institutional_logic: Trade warnings and carried memory for mineral feeding, light, grooming, travel, credible attention, and suitable reproduction sites.
material_incentives: Keep the host alive, secure light and salts, protect rootlets, place seed beads near useful routes, and retain enough credibility to remain carried.
internal_shames: Trading old fear for attention until no ecology believes it
prestige_markers: Warnings confirmed by roads or mats
taboo_triggers: Live sensory filaments cut during disputed testimony
emotional_display_norms: Appetite, alarm, resistance, and cooperation appear through color, leaf angle, rootlet pressure, sap, and seed shedding.
trust_defaults: Responds to regular feeding and careful touch; treats concealment or rough removal as threat.

groups.label: Arrival-terrace candle fungal road
institutional_logic: Maintain safe traffic by comparing carried chemistry, remembered conduct, food contributions, disease disclosure, and testimony from partner organisms.
material_incentives: Receive clean biological matter, prevent contamination, keep reliable traffic, and preserve credit with breeding-ground and producer partners.
internal_shames: Mistaking loud testimony for complete truth
emotional_display_norms: Invitation and refusal appear as candle brightness, gaps, bitter beads, dark lanes, and slow reopening.
trust_defaults: Treats burden-flower color as one affidavit among chemistry, pressure, wash residue, and remembered family conduct.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: Portable life makes care work time-sensitive: delaying grooming protects departure position while degrading the symbiont and the family's route credibility.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Give family actors choices among time, comfort, evidence, and route access instead of treating care as free background labor.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: Warnings earn food and attention, so the flower benefits from strong signals while depending on long-term credibility with hosts, roads, and mats.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Let hunger, care, and social opportunity change signal intensity while keeping current danger unresolved until compared.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: The route can price uncertainty and request more legible evidence without possessing complete diagnosis or authority over every participant.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Express response through candle lanes and bitter footing, with proportional local costs instead of omniscient punishment.

misread_patterns: A hurried host may call old memory false because it is inconvenient
A caring host may mistake feeding for ownership of the report
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Keep family humor affectionate and defensive while the flower's needs remain materially binding.

misread_patterns: The flower may read grooming delay as abandonment
The flower may treat a boundary-preserving transfer as removal threat
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Use rootlet release, leaf angle, and signal clarity to show negotiation while preserving the host's right to refuse a painful attachment point.

role_pressure_fields.summary: A young Sa'auei'a learning to perform portable symbiont care under family schedule, public observation, and bodily discomfort.
failure_modes: Treating discomfort as permission to silence
Offering evidence after its chain is broken

role_pressure_fields.summary: A family teacher who can witness care and testimony while leaving the child, flower, and road their own authority.
failure_modes: Declaring a diagnosis from one bloom
Using shame as a substitute for evidence

role_pressure_fields.summary: A small mobile plant whose alarm, appetite, credibility, attachment, and reproduction are one entangled bargaining position.
obligations: Avoid spending credibility on hunger-amplified repetition
failure_modes: Forcing attention through badly placed seeds

known_context.text: The child knows this flower's care routine, recent shelter history, family departure schedule, and common meanings of its current color order.

beliefs.text: The child believes the alarm is old and partly hunger-amplified, while recognizing that the road may price the uncertainty anyway.

misreads.text: The child may read public attention as unfair accusation and treat fast concealment as a harmless scheduling choice.

must_not_know.text: The child cannot know whether the violet residue indicates active danger, harmless old memory, or a signal changed by appetite until other evidence emerges.

known_context.text: The cousin knows grooming sequence, public witness expectations, fungal-road signals, and the family's current schedule and credit.

beliefs.text: The cousin believes care and testimony can be separated into observable steps without granting any one participant total authority.

misreads.text: The cousin may underweight how strongly public observation turns a routine lesson into shame for the child.

must_not_know.text: The cousin cannot convert the road's candle response into a complete diagnosis or command it to restore passage.

known_context.text: The flower carries host sweat, immune chemistry, emotional state, fungal-road scent, grooming memory, and old shelter residue through embodied channels.

beliefs.text: The flower's behavior treats mineral hunger, safe light, credible attention, and continued travel as immediate goods.

misreads.text: The flower may respond to delayed care or careful separation as threat and intensify an otherwise stale report.

must_not_know.text: The flower does not know the whole family's route plan or the fungal road's final interpretation beyond visible, chemical, and pressure feedback.

author_only_boundaries.text: The child, cousin, exact color order, old rain-shelter residue, dialogue, and playthrough outcomes are fixture-local inventions rather than committed historical canon.
The durable canon contribution is the general burden-flower grooming contract in the owning organism note; the fixture dramatizes possible practice at one already established kind of locality.

open_questions.question: Which native Sa'auei'a terms will eventually name grooming roles, route-witness cords, mineral-wash tools, and burden-flower life stages?
open_questions.notes: The fixture uses descriptive English handles and does not claim Weksa authority.

open_questions.question: Do different fungal-road lineages compare grooming runoff directly, through partner organisms, or only as a local custom at some breeding grounds?
open_questions.notes: The authored elaboration establishes the local practice and its evidentiary role without claiming one universal planetary procedure.
